run_metadata.coverage_summary: SEVERELY DEGRADED RUN — FIFTH CONSECUTIVE egress outage (same condition as 2026-10-21, 2026-10-22, 2026-10-23 and 2026-10-24). The execution environment's network policy still blocks ALL outbound HTTPS. The agent proxy reports enabled:true with no recent relay failures, but a direct proxy CONNECT to every host answers 403 (policy denial — verified this run against www.tenders.gov.au, www.tenders.vic.gov.au AND example.com, all 403 'CONNECT tunnel failed'), and WebFetch returns getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND for every host (verified against www.tenders.gov.au). Per /root/.ccr/README.md a 403 CONNECT is a policy denial that must be reported, not routed around. So NO tender portal, detail page or specification document could be opened on any tier. The only working external channel is WebSearch (routed via Anthropic infrastructure, which sits on the proxy no-proxy allow-list), returning titles/URLs/model-summarised snippets dominated by stale cached data; it cannot read JavaScript-rendered live portals (buy.nsw, tenders.vic, QTenders, NT QTOL, Tenders ACT all returned 'JavaScript Disabled' shells this run), follow pagination, or open attachments. Tier 1 (AusTender + all state/territory portals), Tier 2 (VendorPanel public tenders, councils, GBE water/energy, universities) and Tier 3 (SAP Business Network Discovery, EstimateOne, BHP/Rio/Fortescue major-buyer portals) were all ATTEMPTED via WebSearch only (6 queries across tiers plus a targeted confirmation search). WebSearch surfaced NO new buyer-originated opportunity that could be opened or corroborated on its own portal this run; the two prior-run unconfirmed ACT/Ports-Victoria candidates (PICE0014832 'Thermal Assisted Aerial Control'; Ports Victoria T421509 Station Pier fender upgrade) were re-checked and STILL could not be corroborated — a targeted search for those exact IDs returned zero matching live results (only stale 2023/2025 Station Pier fender notices and paid-aggregator rows). Per the fidelity rule nothing unverified is captured as a confirmed tender. The 5 currently-open opportunities previously captured on 2026-10-16..20 (when WebFetch worked) are carried forward at headline level because their published closing dates (2026-11-12 .. 2026-12-11) remain within their open windows today (2026-10-25). NO genuinely new buyer-originated source could be confirmed this run (WebSearch-only); new_sources_found is therefore 0 and this is noted honestly in gaps.
gaps: CRITICAL TOOLING OUTAGE (5th consecutive run; unchanged from 2026-10-21/22/23/24): outbound HTTPS is blocked by the environment's network policy. A direct proxy CONNECT answers 403 ('CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403') for every host tested this run — www.tenders.gov.au, www.tenders.vic.gov.au and example.com — and WebFetch returns getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND. The proxy /__agentproxy/status endpoint reports enabled:true, bundleCoversEveryHost:true and recentRelayFailures:[] (i.e. the proxy itself is healthy; the 403 is an upstream egress-policy denial, not a proxy fault). Per the proxy README a 403 CONNECT is a policy denial that must be reported, not routed around. No live tender portal, detail page or document could be opened on any tier.

Because detail pages were unreachable, NO deliverables / requirements / evaluation-criteria / document / contact extraction was possible this run. All 5 tenders are headline-level only (counted in entries_pending_detail); their fields derive from prior runs (2026-10-16..20) and must be re-verified on the live portals once egress is restored.

SOURCE DISCOVERY DEGRADED: the mandatory hunt for NEW buyer-originated sources could only run through WebSearch this run. No genuinely new buyer-originated source could be confirmed (WebSearch surfaced only already-known portals/platforms — AusTender Supplier Portal/women-owned-business register, which is the already-recorded Commonwealth Supplier Portal; VendorPanel council migrations already in the known set; SAP Ariba used by Endeavour Energy / Brisbane City Council / Metro Trains, all already known). new_sources_found = 0 this run (honest). Source discovery to be resumed properly once a live portal can be opened.

PRIOR-RUN UNCONFIRMED CANDIDATES re-checked and STILL unverified this run (recorded here, NOT captured as tenders): (1) ACT RFT PICE0014832 'Thermal Assisted Aerial Control' — a targeted search for this exact ID again returned ZERO matching live results; (2) ACT PIJC0012268 'Interpreting and Translating Services' — not re-corroborated; (3) Ports Victoria T421509 'Station Pier fender upgrade' — a targeted search returned only stale 2023 Notices-to-Mariners and a closed 2025 pile-rehab/fender tender (T110173, closed 2025-12-01), NOT a current T421509 notice; (4) Goulburn Valley Water Shepparton WTP disinfection upgrade (aggregator id 611046) — buyer portal unreadable; (5) NSW 'New Electric Bus Program — Technical Advisor Services'; (6) Federal ANNPSR 'Commercial Pressurised Water Reactor Technical Support Services'. All require live-portal verification once egress is restored. None invented.

WebSearch index is stale: queries for Oct/Nov-2026 closings on every Tier 1 portal returned predominantly mid-2026 (closed) listings, paid-aggregator rows (australiantenders.com.au, projectory.com.au) or platform/landing/'JavaScript Disabled' shells. Exhaustive Tier 1 coverage was NOT achieved this run.

Tier 1 state portals (buy.nsw, tenders.vic, QTenders/supply.qld, Tenders WA/SA/TAS, NT QTOL, Tenders ACT) are JavaScript-rendered; WebSearch returned only cached shells (Tenders ACT and Buying for Victoria both returned literal 'JavaScript Disabled' pages this run), so current open-tender lists were not visible.

None of the 5 carried-forward tenders could be independently re-confirmed on their live portals this run (egress blocked). They are carried forward solely on the basis of their previously-captured, still-open published closing dates (GPSnet EOI DOT46088 closes 2026-11-20; WorkCover occupational rehab FOL26-3030 2026-11-30; Latrobe Regional Health payroll RFQ2262 2026-11-18; ACT Healthy Waterways PICE0014602 2026-11-12; Ports Victoria Station Pier T421508 2026-12-11) — all still within their open windows as of 2026-10-25.

Tier 3 private sector: SAP Business Network Discovery, EstimateOne, BHP/Rio Tinto/Fortescue/Woodside/Santos, Woolworths/Coles, Qantas and NFP/health supplier portals are registration/login-gated and/or not readable via WebSearch; no publicly-visible corporate RFx could be confirmed. No corporate opportunities were invented. These portals remain recorded in prior discovered_sources.
Invitation-only corporate RFx (e.g. management-consultancy RFPs) remain out of scope and were not fabricated.
recommended_seed_additions: OPERATIONAL (not a tender source) — ESCALATION: This routine has now been unable to reach ANY live portal for FIVE consecutive runs (2026-10-21/22/23/24/25). The routine CANNOT perform its core job (open buyer portals and extract deliverables) until the environment is reconfigured with outbound HTTPS access to the tender-portal hosts (or an allow-list added).
